key_insight: Curiosity-0826-4B broadens zero-shot medical event prediction to pediatric patients and adult mortality while reducing laboratory prediction error by 18–46% versus its predecessor.
clinical_relevance: A shared model could support prediction across multiple clinical outcomes without separate task-specific training, but clinical utility remains unproven.
method: Generative model trained on Epic Cosmos to simulate patient timelines.
Expanded population coverage and richer clinical event representations, including documented death.
Scaling-guided pretraining produced a 4.3B-parameter model with a 16K context window.
evidence_signal: Evaluations reported AUROCs of 0.742–0.785 for pediatric asthma diagnosis, 0.829–0.852 for pediatric asthma exacerbation, 0.820–0.847 for pediatric sickle cell crisis, and 0.821–0.942 for adult mortality.
watch_item: Local calibration, subgroup performance, generalization to new settings, and prospective clinical utility require further validation before deployment.
paper_title: Curiosity-0826-4B: Generative Medical Event Sequence Modeling Across Pediatric and Adult Populations
